task: Nonlinear 1-D regression (4x4 NMOS input-output fully-connected network, coupled learning)
headline: clean MSE ~1.7e-5; 3 device-mismatch chips (1x model) stay same-order (noise adds a modest error floor)
noise_model: 1x device-mismatch model: per-device VTO offset (sigma 10 mV) + per-device drive-strength/kp factor (sigma 0.5%), fixed per chip (shipped as chip_1/2/3.npz, data only); free & clamp independently mismatched; plus read noise (sigma = 0.5% of the input full scale).
validation: ngspice DC operating-point solve (free + clamped phases)
data_layout: runs/{clean,noisy_chip1,noisy_chip2,noisy_chip3}/ each with run_meta.json + curve.npz + gates.npz (+ chip.npz for noisy)
